description:
We are working with a rapidly growing startup in the online betting industry, building an innovative online betting platform.

We are looking for a talented Frontend React Developer to join their remote development team and help build and improve a high-performance, scalable product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance the platform using React.js.

  • Build responsive, high-performance and user-friendly interfaces.

  • Write clean, maintainable and scalable code.

  • Work closely with developers, product and other stakeholders to deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews, bug fixing and continuous improvement.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimise application performance.

  • Stay up to date with modern frontend technologies and best practices.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Frontend Developer, with strong React.js expertise.

  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.

  • Experience building responsive and scalable web applications.

  • Good understanding of REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.

  • Experience with Git and modern frontend development practices.

  • Experience working remotely and delivering projects independently.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Intermediate English.

  • Ability to take ownership and work with minimal supervision.

  • Experience in PHP/Laravel is a plus, but not essential.

Why join?

  • Fully remote position.

  • Opportunity to work on an innovative and rapidly growing betting platform.

  • High level of ownership and impact.

  • Dynamic startup environment with plenty of room to grow.

If you're a React Developer looking for an opportunity to work on a fast-growing product and make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
